h265_no_go2rtc.description:
Channel {channel} of {host} only streams H.265/HEVC. The live view in Home Assistant will only work in HEVC-capable browsers (Safari/macOS, Edge on Windows with HEVC extensions, mobile apps). On Linux Chrome/Chromium/Firefox you will see a still-image snapshot instead of live video.

To enable live view in any browser, install **WebRTC Camera** (AlexxIT) via HACS, or enable the bundled go2rtc via `default_config` in `configuration.yaml`. The integration will then auto-register the stream and go2rtc will transcode H.265 to H.264 in real time. Restart Home Assistant after the change.
h265_no_go2rtc.title: H.265 stream on channel {channel} — live view limited
